Something soft being crushed.

Blood and something besides blood spurted out.

Still Sorimachi was laughing.
But there was no doubt now.

His skull had split. The thing holding his life together was broken.

I had killed this man.

Toward the rock where he had been sitting.

Behind it.

A box.
A large box.

Large enough, say,
for a tsurugi to fit inside.

The dying man's fingers undid the clasp and opened the lid.
That seemed to use up the last of his strength.

One last look at me.
One mocking smile, as though giving me his blessing.

Ichizo Sorimachi died.

Inside it...
Red steel.

That steel. That spider.
While I watched, she changed her shape.

en.html: Such relief, my legs gave way. It had been a lie. Sorimachi had not killed Muramasa. The device had been blocking our communications. That was why. Thank goodness. Full of that joy, ◆I picked up the cane. The gangster's sword cane.
en.text:
Such relief, my legs gave way.

It had been a lie.
Sorimachi had not killed Muramasa.

The device had been blocking our communications. That was why.

Thank goodness.
Full of that joy, ◆I picked up the cane. The gangster's sword cane.

ja.html: 安堵する余り、俺はへたり込んだ。 　嘘だったのだ。 　雪車町は村正を殺していなかった。 　通信が途絶していたのは遮断装置のため。 　良かった。 　喜びに満たされながら、◆俺は杖を拾う。筋者が得物 としていた仕込み杖を。
ja.text:
安堵する余り、俺はへたり込んだ。

　嘘だったのだ。
　雪車町は村正を殺していなかった。

　通信が途絶していたのは遮断装置のため。

　良かった。
　喜びに満たされながら、◆俺は杖を拾う。筋者が得物
としていた仕込み杖を。

Muramasa"..."
en.text: Kageaki"...Muramasa?"Muramasa"..."

ja.html:

村正「…………」

en.html:
Something was wrong.

Why was Muramasa looking at me like that?
With those eyes... as if saying goodbye?

And what was I doing?


Why was I drawing the sword from the cane?
Blade ready in my hands—what was I going to do?

None of this made sense.

Something I could not understand was moving my arms and legs.

This was just like that time.

ja.html:
おかしい。

　村正はどうして、そんな目で俺を見るのだ？
　そんな――別れを告げるような目で。

　そして、俺は何をしている？


　何故、仕込みを抜く？
　白刃を構えて、どうしようというのだ？

　わけのわからない事が起きている。

　わけのわからぬものが、俺の手足を操っている。

　――これは、あの時と同じ。

en.html:
This was where killing out of hatred ended.
The price: killing someone I loved.

The law of the Balance of Good and Evil.

I had killed Ichizo Sorimachi.
Now I would kill Muramasa also.

en.html:
To my desperate shout, one small movement of her head.
Side to side.

Muramasa stayed where she was.


I walked toward her.

Sword from the cane in my hands. One step, then another.

No.
Bas. Stop this.

My own body would not listen to me. It obeyed one law only.

Closer.


Both my arms raised the bare blade against the setting sun.

必死の叫びに、応えたのは首の動き。
　左右に、小さく。

　村正はその場を動かない。


　俺は歩み寄る。

　仕込み刀を手に、一歩一歩。

　――嫌だ。
　――やめろ。

　俺の肉体は俺の拒絶を黙殺する。
　一つの戒律に服従する。

　近寄る。


　両腕が、白刃を夕陽に<ruby>翳<rt>かざ</rt></ruby>す。

Her lips moved once more.
A voice that made no sound.

Please.

And then—

en.html: She broke apart in my arms and scattered. Glittered in the setting sun. That also soon disappeared. Alone, I stood there. I had been released. Freedom was there. Nothing else was left to me. Everything that had held me was gone. My mission.◆ The curse.◆ Hatred.◆ Love.
en.text:
She broke apart in my arms and scattered.
Glittered in the setting sun. That also soon disappeared.

Alone, I stood there.

I had been released.
Freedom was there.

Nothing else was left to me.

Everything that had held me was gone.

My mission.◆
The curse.◆
Hatred.◆
Love.

ja.html: 腕の中で、砕けて散った。 　夕日を浴びて煌き、それもすぐに消える。 　独り、俺は立ち尽くす。 　解放されていた。 　自由があった。 　もう俺には何も無かった。 　俺を縛る全てが無かった。 　使命も。◆ 　呪戒のろいも。◆ 　憎悪も。◆ 　愛も。

　夕日を浴びて煌き、それもすぐに消える。

　自由があった。

　もう俺には何も無かった。

　俺を縛る全てが無かった。

　使命も。◆

　憎悪も。◆
